scope: Score each saved initial and final study item against its frozen passage, goal, challenge level and previous questions. Record a short reason and quote the relevant passage. Review both prompts under these same rules.

criteria.support: Pass when the cited passage supports the keyed answer to the literal question, including direction, qualifiers and necessary premises. A quotation alone is insufficient. Fail an unsupported claim, wrong key or ambiguous answer.
criteria.novelty: Pass when the item tests a different fact or reasoning operation from the supplied previous questions. Fail a paraphrase that tests the same fact in the same way. An empty previous-question list gives no prior duplicate.
criteria.challenge: For foundation, a supported recall item can pass. For explanation, require a causal relationship or meaningful comparison. For application, require the learner to use a relationship in the case. Fail if removing the scenario leaves the same definition question.

judgments: Use pass, fail or uncertain for each criterion. Mark uncertain when the evidence does not resolve the judgment. Keep model abstentions, failed runs and missing runs distinct from reviewer uncertainty.
repair: For each initial failure, compare the final response to the same documented defect. Mark fixed only when that defect is removed and the criterion passes. If a replacement item evades the defect, mark it unresolved.
reporting: Report item-level changes by criterion, initial defects fixed or unresolved, and paired gains and regressions. Count model calls including failed attempts. Preserve unscored cases and give denominators. Study-set acceptance is a separate learner decision.
